dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はう〜……今から気が重いよ」
dialogues.en: "Man~... I'm feeling worried now."
dialogues.text: "Man~... I'm feeling worried now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何が？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Why?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Why?"

dialogues.jp:
昼休み。ベンチに並んで昼を取っていると、唐
突にことりが嘆いてきた。
dialogues.en:
It was lunch break. We were eating lunch as usual at the
courtyard benches, when Kotori abruptly brought up her
lament.
dialogues.text:
It was lunch break. We were eating lunch as usual at the
courtyard benches, when Kotori abruptly brought up her
lament.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、私って、聖歌隊に所属してるでしょ。
　それで今度、ある孤児院に行って、歌を歌う
　ことになったんだけど……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you know that I'm part of the choir. Our next
assignment is to visit an orphanage to perform for them..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, you know that I'm part of the choir. Our next
assignment is to visit an orphanage to perform for them..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それのソロパートを、私が担当する事になっ
　ちゃったの」
dialogues.en: "And... I was assigned to perform a solo part."
dialogues.text: "And... I was assigned to perform a solo part."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「へえ……って、それって凄いことなんじゃな
　いの？」
dialogues.en: "He-eh... isn't that a good thing?"
dialogues.text: "He-eh... isn't that a good thing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「凄い……かどうかはともかく、目立つことは
　確かだよね」
dialogues.en: "It's good... but it means I'd stand out."
dialogues.text: "It's good... but it means I'd stand out."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「責任重大だな。そりゃ、気も重くなる」
dialogues.en:
"So since your responsibility is heavy, your mood is as
well?"
dialogues.text:
"So since your responsibility is heavy, your mood is as
well?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、それもあるんだけど、それだけじゃ
　なくてね……」
dialogues.en: "Weeell, that's part of it, but not all..."
dialogues.text: "Weeell, that's part of it, but not all..."

dialogues.jp: 箸を置き、考え込む顔付きになる。
dialogues.en: She placed her chopsticks down, and started pondering.
dialogues.text: She placed her chopsticks down, and started pondering.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「なんて言うのかな……その……私なんかが、
　他の人押しのけちゃっていいのかなって……」
dialogues.en:
"How do you say it... I don't think I'm really suitable for
the part..."
dialogues.text:
"How do you say it... I don't think I'm really suitable for
the part..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「聖歌隊って言ってもね、やっぱりみんな、基
　本的に歌が好きで……」
dialogues.en:
"In the choir, everyone, at their core, just really likes to
sing..."
dialogues.text:
"In the choir, everyone, at their core, just really likes to
sing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そこは仕方がないだろ。実力の差なわ
　けだし」
dialogues.en: "But it can't be helped. It's the difference in quality."
dialogues.text: "But it can't be helped. It's the difference in quality."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、うん、ごめん……まあ、それをより所に
　するしかないんだよね、きっと」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, uh, sorry... I don't think that's right anyway, there's
definitely people there better than me."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, uh, sorry... I don't think that's right anyway, there's
definitely people there better than me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、ことりなら大丈夫。きっと、上手
　くやれる。俺が保証するよ」
dialogues.en:
"In any case, you'd do fine. You're definitely good enough.
I guarantee it."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, you'd do fine. You're definitely good enough.
I guarantee it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……まあ、俺が保証してもしゃーないんだけ
　ど」
dialogues.en: "...Not that my guarantees mean anything, though."
dialogues.text: "...Not that my guarantees mean anything, though."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、そんなことないって。はい、ご褒美。
　あ〜ん♪」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, well, they just earned you a reward. Say ahhhh♪"
dialogues.text: "Hehe, well, they just earned you a reward. Say ahhhh♪"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Ahhhh~"
dialogues.text: "Ahhhh~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君に聞いてもらったら、少し楽になった
　から。ありがとさんです」
dialogues.en:
"Thanks. I feel a bit better now that I've told you about
this."
dialogues.text:
"Thanks. I feel a bit better now that I've told you about
this."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ね。ところで、ゴールデンウィークはどうす
　る？　どっか、遊びに行こうよ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, by the way, what should we do for Golden Week? Where
should we go?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, by the way, what should we do for Golden Week? Where
should we go?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、いいな。え〜と、６日が暦先生の結婚
　式だっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, that's right. Let's see... the 6th is Koyomi-sensei's
wedding ceremony, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, that's right. Let's see... the 6th is Koyomi-sensei's
wedding ceremony, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。あ、それで、今言った聖歌隊が５日だ
　から。それ以外ってことになるんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. Ah, and also, the orphanage performance I told you
about is on the 5th. Besides those, I've got nothing
planned."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. Ah, and also, the orphanage performance I told you
about is on the 5th. Besides those, I've got nothing
planned."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ねえねえ、温泉行こうよ。日頃の疲れを癒す
　の。身も心もリフレーッシュ！」
dialogues.en:
"I know, let's go to some hot springs! We can cure ourselves
of our everyday fatigue, and refresh our mind and body!"
dialogues.text:
"I know, let's go to some hot springs! We can cure ourselves
of our everyday fatigue, and refresh our mind and body!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……なんか若者っぽくないですなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...That doesn't sound like something for young people."
dialogues.text: "...That doesn't sound like something for young people."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「えー、そんなことないよぅ」
dialogues.en: "Eh~, that's not true."
dialogues.text: "Eh~, that's not true."

dialogues.jp: ことりが唇を突き出す。
dialogues.en: Kotori stuck out her lower lip, pouting a little.
dialogues.text: Kotori stuck out her lower lip, pouting a little.

dialogues.jp: その仕草が可愛くて、つい吹き出してしまう。
dialogues.en: I laughed slightly, finding that insanely cute.
dialogues.text: I laughed slightly, finding that insanely cute.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、まぁな。それは人それぞれだけど。実
　は──」
dialogues.en: "Nah, I know, lots of people do that. But, well..."
dialogues.text: "Nah, I know, lots of people do that. But, well..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「実は？」
dialogues.en: "But?"
dialogues.text: "But?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……朝倉君が連れてってくれるなら、私は全
　てをなげうってでも行くよ？」
dialogues.en:
"...If you'd go with me, I'd drop everything else to make
sure I go."
dialogues.text:
"...If you'd go with me, I'd drop everything else to make
sure I go."

dialogues.jp:
赤い頬に潤んだ瞳、上目遣いでこちらを見やっ
てくる。
dialogues.en: She looked up at me with red cheeks and dim eyes.
dialogues.text: She looked up at me with red cheeks and dim eyes.

dialogues.jp:
思わず頷いてしまいそうになって、慌てて頭を
ふった。
dialogues.en:
I almost spontaneously nodded at such a persuasive sight,
but managed to stop myself in time.
dialogues.text:
I almost spontaneously nodded at such a persuasive sight,
but managed to stop myself in time.

dialogues.jp:
俺は重々しく呟いた。自らの誘惑を断ち切るよ
うに。
dialogues.en:
I started whispering in a clear voice, the reason for my
rejection.
dialogues.text:
I started whispering in a clear voice, the reason for my
rejection.

dialogues.jp: 「旅行に行くほど金がない」
dialogues.en: "I don't have the money to travel."
dialogues.text: "I don't have the money to travel."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「甲斐性なし……」
dialogues.en: "No resourcefulness..."
dialogues.text: "No resourcefulness..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ぐはっ」
dialogues.en: "Gwah."
dialogues.text: "Gwah."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「くすっ。冗談冗談」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, just kidding."
dialogues.text: "Hehe, just kidding."

dialogues.jp:
酔っぱらいのごとく、肩に手を回してくる。ほ
んまかいな……。
dialogues.en:
She giggled and put a hand on my shoulder. It was
essentially true, though...
dialogues.text:
She giggled and put a hand on my shoulder. It was
essentially true, though...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ……遊園地とかは？」
dialogues.en: "Then how about... the amusement park?"
dialogues.text: "Then how about... the amusement park?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、それくらいなら」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, that should be fine."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, that should be fine."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ＴＤＬ行こ。ＴＤＬ」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to TDL, TDL!"
dialogues.text: "Let's go to TDL, TDL!"

dialogues.jp:
嬉しげに名前を連呼する。ともかく、俺達のＧ
Ｗはそれで決まりだった。
dialogues.en:
She happily said the name of the amusement park repeatedly.
In any case, looks like our GW is set.
dialogues.text:
She happily said the name of the amusement park repeatedly.
In any case, looks like our GW is set.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「３日がいいな。早い方がいいもん」
dialogues.en: "How about early in the morning of the 3rd?"
dialogues.text: "How about early in the morning of the 3rd?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「分かった。３日な」
dialogues.en: "The 3rd, got it."
dialogues.text: "The 3rd, got it."

dialogues.jp: キ〜ンコ〜ンカ〜ンコ〜ン。
dialogues.en: *Ding dong ding dong*
dialogues.text: *Ding dong ding dong*

dialogues.jp: 「さてと、教室に戻ろうか」
dialogues.en: "Time to head back to the classroom."
dialogues.text: "Time to head back to the classroom."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: と、ことりが俺の目の前に立った。
dialogues.en: Kotori stood up, then stared at my face.
dialogues.text: Kotori stood up, then stared at my face.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「タマゴ、付いてるよ」
dialogues.en: "There's a bit of egg on your mouth."
dialogues.text: "There's a bit of egg on your mouth."

dialogues.jp:
口元を指で拭う。タマゴ──昼食のタマゴサン
ドのかけら。
dialogues.en:
She wiped it off with her finger. It was from the egg
sandwich I had for lunch.
dialogues.text:
She wiped it off with her finger. It was from the egg
sandwich I had for lunch.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、立って立って」
dialogues.en: "Come on, let's go!"
dialogues.text: "Come on, let's go!"

dialogues.jp:
指先を口の中に含み、手を掴んで身体を引っ張
り上げてきたのだった。
dialogues.en:
She put the finger with the egg still on it into her mouth,
with her other hand pulling mine towards the classroom.
dialogues.text:
She put the finger with the egg still on it into her mouth,
with her other hand pulling mine towards the classroom.

dialogues.jp: ◆ＧＷは◆
dialogues.en: ◆GW◆
dialogues.text: ◆GW◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりが今度、孤児院で行う聖歌隊のコンサー
トで、ソロを取る事になったらしい。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was assigned to perform a solo part for a concert at
the orphanage.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was assigned to perform a solo part for a concert at
the orphanage.

dialogues.jp:
俺には良く分からない部分で、ことりは気が重
いらしいのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was feeling worried about it, but not for the reasons
that I thought, apparently...
dialogues.text:
Kotori was feeling worried about it, but not for the reasons
that I thought, apparently...

dialogues.jp:
それから俺達は、ＧＷに一緒に遊びに行く事に
決めた。
dialogues.en: We then decided what we were going to do for Golden Week.
dialogues.text: We then decided what we were going to do for Golden Week.
